price_artifacts.note: exact 2/3 open without a volume surge

_comments.shortlist_size: the live scanner keeps the top N candidates per market (confidence x 50 + technical score); the backtest simulates the same cut
_comments.pattern_tuning.family_alpha: chance of at least one false 'proven edge' across all pattern x market cells (two-sided, Bonferroni)
_comments.pattern_tuning.n_tests: null = number of bullish patterns x 3 markets (18); set 1 for the unadjusted 95% rule
_comments.backtest.stop_slippage_pct / entry_slipp: extra slippage on stop-loss exits and buy-stop entries (market orders once triggered); a single number applies to every market
_comments.backtest.index_dividend_yield_pct: estimated yield added to the price-index baseline (^GSPC, ^NSEI); de = 0 because ^GDAXI is a performance index. Changing it needs a backtest re-run
_comments.backtest.step / breakout_wait: 1 / 1 = replay every trading day with a one-day buy-stop, like the 07:30 scan; the old grid was 5 / 15 (python -m atlas2 backtest --legacy-grid)
_comments.backtest.window: pattern look-back, at least 144 bars (cup-and-handle needs a 140-bar base)
_comments.backtest.max_hold: time exit: sell at the close of the Nth trading day after the fill if neither stop nor target was hit; the backtest numbers assume you do this
_comments.backtest.entry_mode: buy_stop (default) or close_confirm (buy at the next open after a close above the entry)
_comments.backtest.seen_on_fill_only: true = only a filled trade blocks its pattern level for 'window' bars
_comments.backtest.price_artifacts: corporate actions the free data leaves unadjusted (backtest only; actions: adjust with ratio, drop_bar, truncate). More can go in data/price_artifacts.json
